title: Battery Expiration Check Failure Rate
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=battery:expiration
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(check_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by device_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often battery expiration check records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each device.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize check_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per device.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which parts of your battery expiration check data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
